text: A retry of a plan's failed draft applies to the failure that was the issue's latest when it was posted: one posted before that failure post gets a note and builds nothing, so a second retry queued while the first draft was open doesn't rebuild the next draft before anyone has looked at it. The factory reads the draft again just before it stores the retry's record, so a close someone made after the factory last read it is theirs, and the retry is answered without a build. A retry's build that can't reach the commit holding the plan's ratification, on a clone that never fetched it once the old draft's branch is gone, answers with a failure for a person, to draft the plan again, instead of failing every poll. The history says a rebuild closed the draft only on the post that closed it.
